name: bank_snapshot
description: Full bank contents as of when the bank was last open, with tab layout and slot order. Returns every item (hundreds of entries), so prefer find_item when you are looking for specific items and game_state's bank section when you just need a rough picture. Use this when you need the whole bank: valuing it, diffing it, or reproducing its tab layout. The game only sends bank contents while the bank is open, so this is unavailable until the player opens a bank once this session, and it is a snapshot from that moment, not live.

outputSchema.description: When available is false the contents are unknown, not empty.

note.description: Why the bank is unavailable, e.g. never opened this session.

capturedAt.description: When the snapshot was taken, i.e. when the bank was last open. ISO-8601 instant, UTC. Transported as a JSON string; no native date-time type is implied.

uniqueItems.description: Number of entries in items, placeholders included.

qty.description: Stack size. 0 means a placeholder: the slot is reserved and the item is NOT owned.

placeholder.description: True when this entry is a reserved empty slot rather than a held item.

bankSlot.description: Index of this item in the bank container. Tab membership derives from it; items are returned in bank display order. Named bankSlot, not slot: slot is the worn-equipment enum elsewhere in this API.

items.description: Every bank entry, in bank display order.

placeholderCount.description: How many entries are placeholders (reserved empty slots, qty 0) rather than held items. Subtract from uniqueItems for a true item count.

tabs.description: Bank only: tab layout as index ranges over items[].bankSlot, rather than a tab field on every item. A tab owns bankSlot start through start+count-1. Tabs 1-9 come first in order; the main tab (tab 0) holds whatever follows them. To list a tab's contents, take the items whose bankSlot falls in its range.

tab.description: Tab number; 0 is the main tab.

count.description: How many slots this tab holds.

main.description: Present and true on the main tab.

currentTab.description: Tab the player had open when the snapshot was taken; 0 is the main tab. Cosmetic - it says nothing about where items live.

leavePlaceholders.description: Whether the player's bank is set to leave placeholders when withdrawing. Explains why qty-0 entries appear.
